questions.fridge_not_cooling: Is the refrigerator not cooling properly?
questions.fridge_compressor_running: Can you hear the compressor running (humming) most of the time?
questions.condenser_coils_dusty: Are the condenser coils (back or bottom of the fridge) covered in dust?
questions.fridge_light_off: Is the fridge's interior light off when the door is open?
questions.door_gap_or_frost: Is there a visible gap in the door seal, or heavy frost build-up?
questions.ws_water_not_draining: Is water left in the washing machine drum after the cycle?
questions.drain_filter_dirty: Is the drain filter full of lint or debris?
questions.ws_wont_start: Does the washing machine refuse to start a cycle?
questions.door_not_latching: Does the door or lid fail to latch or lock?
questions.ws_not_spinning: Does the drum fail to spin?
questions.ws_overloaded: Is the drum overloaded with clothes?
questions.mw_not_heating: Is the microwave running but not heating food?
questions.mw_display_works: Do the microwave's display and light still work?
questions.mw_no_display: Is the microwave completely dead (blank display, nothing works)?
questions.socket_ok: Do other devices work in the same power socket?
questions.turntable_ring_dirty_or_missing: Is the turntable roller ring dirty, misplaced or missing?
questions.fan_slow_or_not_starting: Does the fan run slowly or fail to start?
questions.fan_humming: Does the fan hum while failing to start properly?
questions.regulator_no_effect: Does changing the regulator setting have no effect on the speed?
questions.fan_noisy: Is the fan unusually noisy while running?
questions.ac_poor_cooling: Is the air conditioner not cooling enough?
questions.ac_filter_dirty: Is the air filter covered in dust?
questions.ac_ice_on_pipes: Is there ice on the indoor unit or the copper pipes?
questions.ac_not_responding_remote: Does the AC fail to respond to its remote?
questions.remote_battery_weak: Are the remote's batteries old or weak?
questions.tv_no_standby_light: Is the TV's standby light off?
questions.tv_screen_black: Is the TV screen black or very dark?
questions.tv_has_sound: Can you still hear sound from the TV?
questions.tv_not_responding_remote: Does the TV fail to respond to the remote?
questions.tv_panel_buttons_work: Do the buttons on the TV itself work?

descriptions.condenser_coils_dirty: Refrigerator: condenser coils are dirty, reducing cooling
descriptions.fridge_no_power: Refrigerator: no power is reaching the fridge
descriptions.door_seal_faulty: Refrigerator: door seal (gasket) is leaking cold air
descriptions.drain_filter_clogged: Washing machine: drain filter is clogged
descriptions.door_lock_issue: Washing machine: door or lid is not latching properly
descriptions.washer_overloaded: Washing machine: drum is overloaded or unbalanced
descriptions.heating_circuit_fault: Microwave: heating circuit fault (magnetron or high-voltage part)
descriptions.mw_fuse_or_board_fault: Microwave: blown fuse or control board fault
descriptions.turntable_support_issue: Microwave: turntable ring or support is dirty or misplaced
descriptions.fan_capacitor_weak: Ceiling fan: capacitor is weak or has failed
descriptions.fan_regulator_fault: Ceiling fan: speed regulator is faulty
descriptions.fan_blades_unbalanced: Ceiling fan: blades are loose or unbalanced
descriptions.ac_filter_clogged: Air conditioner: air filter is clogged
descriptions.ac_low_refrigerant: Air conditioner: low refrigerant gas (possible leak)
descriptions.ac_remote_battery_issue: Air conditioner: remote batteries are weak
descriptions.tv_display_or_backlight_fault: Television: display panel or backlight fault
descriptions.fix_clean_coils: FIX: Unplug the fridge and clean the condenser coils with a brush or vacuum
descriptions.fix_check_fridge_power: FIX: Check the plug, socket and fuse/MCB
descriptions.fix_replace_door_gasket: FIX: Clean or replace the door gasket (seal)
descriptions.fix_clean_drain_filter: FIX: Switch off, then clean the drain filter
descriptions.fix_check_door_latch: FIX: Close the door or lid firmly; if it still fails, get the latch repaired
descriptions.fix_reduce_load: FIX: Remove some clothes and rebalance the load
descriptions.fix_reseat_turntable: FIX: Clean and correctly reseat the turntable ring and glass plate
descriptions.fix_tighten_fan_blades: FIX: Switch off, then tighten the blade screws and balance the blades
descriptions.fix_clean_ac_filter: FIX: Clean or wash the air filter
descriptions.fix_replace_tv_remote: FIX: Replace the remote's batteries or the remote itself
descriptions.advice_call_technician: SAFETY: Do not open the appliance yourself - call a qualified technician
